title: UI follow-ups: hero badges, sticky nav pill, desktop navbar overlap
request: Hero badges not keyboard-reachable; wrong active pill in the team-page sticky nav; Home pill overlapping the wordmark at 1024 to 1280px

criteria.text: Team-page hero badges are real buttons with an accessible name (the badge name), reachable by Tab, opened by Enter and Space and by tap, at least 44x44 with a visible focus ring, and open the same dialog as before
criteria.evidence: QA final code: phone hero + career badges are buttons named Competitive Champion / Runner-Up / Clutch Performer, Tab reaches them, Enter/Space open the dialog, Escape returns focus, hit area 44x44 (elementFromPoint at corners), visible ring; desktop 1280 and 1100: buttons 32x32, tooltip on focus and hover, Enter/Space/click open dialog, focus returns, 0 stuck tooltips. Tab order before: 0 badge stops in 90 presses. .factory/evidence/T-261102-ui-follow-ups-hero-badge/after/team390-focus-ring.png

criteria.text: Badges on other pages that share the component (home Top Teams cards, /stats rows) look the same as before and are never a button nested inside a link (no nested interactive elements)
criteria.evidence: QA: /stats at 390 Compact and Detailed: badge tap never expands a card (tap, Escape, X, overlay); at 1280 / and /stats rows: badges are plain divs inside links, no tab stop, hover tooltip works; scan of 10 states: 0 a>button / button>a pairs from badges (one pre-existing 'Compare Team' pair is identical on the old build). Pixel compare of badge areas before/after: 0 differing px

criteria.text: Sticky nav: the active pill matches the section in view after tapping Overview, Stats, Matchups, Matches and Career, and while scrolling; aria-current is correct
criteria.evidence: QA 12 taps each at 390, 360, 1280: 0 mismatches, exactly one aria-current equal to the tapped pill (before: 7 of 12 wrong); keyboard Enter/Space work. LIMIT: scrolling by mouse in 100px steps, 3-4 steps per width differ from a strict 'section top at or above nav' rule because of observer-band hand-offs; QA judged them reasonable, order is always right and Career lights at the bottom

criteria.text: Sticky nav: the active pill is scrolled into view in the 390px bar, and each button's accessible name contains its visible words
criteria.evidence: QA: active pill fully visible in the bar (bar scrollLeft 0->70->145 at 390, 0->85->175 at 360); aria-labels contain the visible words ('Navigate to Matches: match history section')

criteria.text: At 1024, 1100, 1280 and 1440px the 717REC wordmark is not overlapped by the Home pill or any nav pill; the navbar is unchanged at 390, 360 and 1440
criteria.evidence: QA at 10 widths 1024-1920 on 3 routes: one row, no overflow, wordmark gap 331.6/407.6/487.6/586.6 at 1024/1100/1180/1279, 47.9 at 1280, 15.9 at 1320, 95.9 at 1440 (was -20px overlap, and Sign in/bell/theme/search were off-screen below ~1268px); icon-only pills with title and accessible names 1024-1279, labels from 1280; pixel-identical to the old build at 1320, 1366, 1440, 1920 and on phones 390/360 closed and open. .factory/evidence/T-261102-ui-follow-ups-hero-badge/before/nav-1024.png vs .factory/evidence/T-261102-ui-follow-ups-hero-badge/after/nav-1024.png. LIMIT: admin and signed-in at 1024 simulated only

criteria.text: No new console errors, no sideways scroll at 360 and 390 on / , /stats and a team page and at 1024 to 1440, touched components' tests pass
criteria.evidence: All 6 required checks pass at HEAD (integrity, typecheck, lint, knip, build, unit 820s). QA: only aborted third-party hosts and the mock 406 in the console; no sideways scroll at 12 widths on /, /stats, team page. Reviewer: 46 targeted tests pass; developer ran 81 files / 593 tests.

reviews.summary: UI follow-ups re-reviewed at HEAD (whole task diff): desktop badges are Tab-reachable buttons with names and focus tooltips; in-link badges (home TeamCard, RankingTeamCell) have no tab stop and no nested button; RankingCard/Compact phone-only; controlled-tooltip flag cannot stick (checked in Radix source and by mutation); rAF hold fix and test verified by mutation; no suppressions in the diff; 46/46 targeted tests pass.

notes.text: From the earlier audits. Known causes: TeamBadge.tsx:143-158 is a div onClick (40x40, no role or name, Tab skips it; TeamBadgeCollection is shared with home TeamCard, RankingCard, RankingCardCompact, RankingTeamCell: check none sits inside a link); TeamDetailsStickyNav.tsx:56-79 lets the last intersecting entry win; desktop brand is squeezed to 61px at 1280 so the wordmark runs into the Home pill (Navbar.tsx).

Reviewer nits, not blocking: tooltip text repeats the badge name for screen readers; no tooltip after the dialog closes for keyboard users; title attr also shows at >=1280 where labels are visible. Behaviour changes to tell Doug: desktop badge click now opens the dialog; phone taps on badges inside the home Top Teams card link now just follow the link. Navbar signed-in/admin at 1024px simulated only.

Notes to tell Doug: desktop badge click now opens the dialog (before: nothing); phone taps on badges inside the home Top Teams card now follow the link; icon-only nav pills at 1024-1279 is a visible desktop change; QA minor: first career badge showed no tooltip once on first keyboard focus (not reproduced); 1320 gap between Contact and Sign in ~12px (same as before).
